about_the_game:
Bounce It is a small arcade-style game built around one simple challenge: Keep the ball bouncing! Miss the timing or forget to bounce and it's game over. The goal is to improve your score, unlock cosmetic skins, and master the rhythm of the bounce.

This demo is the very first version of the game. It's not just a test or prototype. It's a fully playable start that represents what could already stand as a complete experience for this project.

While the game is still in development, this version includes the core gameplay loop and a basic progression system. It may receive updates to experiment with new features, tweak the balance, or polish certain aspects based on player feedback.

If you're looking for a focused, skill-based arcade challenge with a clean presentation, Bounce It is ready to deliver just that.

Will this free demo version get updates?

Yes. While this demo already represents a slice of what the final version aims to be, it may receive updates to test new features, polish gameplay, and improve overall quality based on feedback. I'm also committed to fixing any issues players encounter to ensure the experience remains smooth and enjoyable.

What to expect in the final version of the game?

The main version aims to build on the never-stop-bouncing mechanic by adding more customization options, new settings, additional languages, upgrades to the progression system, and most exciting of all: multiple game modes.

All feedback is welcome.

Bounce It is being developed solo as a first commercial project. Feedback at this stage is incredibly valuable and helps guide future updates and improvements.
